body.statement: For every deterministic \(v\in\Delta(\mathcal B)\), \(\widehat\tau(v)-\tau_W=\sum_{(b,i)\in\mathcal T}\xi_{bi}(v)-\sum_{b=1}^B d_b(v)\mu_b\), where \(\{\xi_{bi}(v),H_{bi}\}\) is a design-based martingale-difference array. Its conditional variances obey \(\sum_{b,i}\mathbb E_{\mathcal D,Y}[\xi_{bi}(v)^2\mid H_{bi}]\le\mathsf G_{\mathcal D}(v;H)\) almost surely and hence \(\mathbb E_{\mathcal D,Y}\sum_{b,i}\xi_{bi}(v)^2\le\overline{\mathsf V}_{\mathcal D,\gamma}(v)\) uniformly over \(Y\in\mathcal Y_{M,\gamma}\).
body.justification: The decomposition separates deterministic calendar bias from assignment noise while retaining the actual probability of each adaptive history.
body.gap: LiZhao2026, equation (3) and Theorem 4, center AIPW at a full-support finite-population contrast; the present decomposition permits focal-arm support zeros off \(W\) and exposes both NCC drift and assignment-law-averaged information.
body.consumer: It supplies the auditable estimating equation and variance accounting needed for an NCC package implementation.
